Disaules: primitive king of Eleusis and founder of the mysteries at Phlius
Hyperphas: leader of the Phlegyans in Greek myth
Phlegethon: river of fire in the Greek underworld
Phlegyas: king of the Lapiths in Greek mythology
Phlias: Greek hero, son of Dionysus
Phlogios: companion of Heracles and the Argonauts
Phorbas: Phlegyan prince and hero of Elis
